svg.title: Work and system-learning loops
svg.desc: The work loop turns a durable work item into capability and context routing, side-effect-free planning and validation, a consequence-based authority decision, authorized mutation or action, evidence and verification, and an integrated outcome. Human-gated work waits for a recorded decision and then returns for authority evaluation. Denied work stops and requires a new or materially changed work item. Evidence is a postcondition and never retroactive permission. The system-learning loop turns failures, friction, and observations into versioned constraints, tests and adversarial review, immutable rollout, live enforcement proof, and recurrence measurement. Only reviewed and proven constraints feed future routing.
